annotation_policy.TEXT_REAL: Human lexical/written-language text presence. Numerals alone were treated as NO TEXT in this annotation pass.
annotation_policy.visible_text_lines: WYSIWYG transcription fragments exactly as entered by the human, split on original newlines; no semantic normalization.
annotation_policy.non_latin_flag_with_transcription: Both substantial transcribed/Latin-like text and substantial non-Latin text were visible.
annotation_policy.non_latin_flag_without_transcription: Non-Latin-only visible text; in this annotation pass these were Japanese-only cases.
annotation_policy.unreadable_flag_with_transcription: The transcribed fragment was readable and additional visible text could not be reliably read.
annotation_policy.unreadable_flag_without_transcription: Text was visibly present but no fragment could be reliably transcribed.
annotation_policy.important: TEXT_REAL is independent human ground truth. Model NULL is candidate-conditioned abstention and must not be redefined as literal text absence.
